interfaces: BrainSettings.brain_id (BRAIN_ID, default when unset or empty, pattern excludes project ids), policy_revision (BRAIN_POLICY_REVISION), config_dir, brain_url
brain-api GET /instance, unauthenticated: schema, brain_id, policy_revision; refuses to start on a BRAIN_ID outside the pattern
BrainClient.verify_instance() and BrainBindingError; health() verifies before sending the bearer
write_env_file writes BRAIN_ID (named brains only) and BRAIN_POLICY_REVISION when absent; compose passes both to every service
write_config rewrites config.yaml atomically and never stores identity
compatibility: An unnamed installation keeps answering and binding as default with no migration. A brain-api older than this change has no /instance and is refused, so brain-api deploys before verifying clients.
rollback: Unset BRAIN_ID and the brain answers default again through the same absence mapping; clients that expect another name refuse it rather than send credentials. Rehearsed in CI by the default fixture and the empty BRAIN_ID test; not rehearsed on a deployed brain.
limitations: Only health() sends credentials today; future authenticated client calls must go through verify_instance
Identity keys in an existing .env are never rewritten by install; changing them is an operator edit and a restart
The brain id pattern is duplicated in brain-api because its image does not ship the agentibrain package
